case.question: What are the ordinary return conditions, and how long does a prepaid refund take after approval?
case.expected: Unused/original packaging/accessories; 5–7 business days after approval, original payment method.

result.answer: Ordinary returns must be requested within 7 days of delivery, with the product unused, in its original packaging, and with all accessories. After a returned item is inspected and approved, a prepaid refund will be processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method.
